summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel RT (Live Patch 10 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 15 SP7)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise kernel 6.4.0-150700.7.34 fixes one security issue

The following security issue was fixed:

- CVE-2026-31431: crypto: algif_aead - Revert to operating out-of-place (bsc#1263689).
